newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian bonds start higher, but tone cautious.
newsitem.headline: Italian bonds start higher, but tone cautious.

text.p: 0720 GMT - Italian BTP futures started higher following other European bonds and higher T-bonds overnight, but market hesitant after a lacklustre lower session Tuesday. Dealers see losses earlier this week largely overdone, but markets likely to be cautious ahead of U.S. GDP and jobs data later this week.
* Lira:975.30/5.60 vs mark at 976.50 area late Tuesday.
